project.title: Eclipse Phase 2e Character & Morph Creator
project.summary: A local-first web tool for creating, validating, saving, resleeving, and printing Eclipse Phase Second Edition characters.

items.title: Complete the first supported creation workflow
items.notes: Core aptitude templates, nine core backgrounds with restricted combat-skill choices, all 14 core careers and matching gear packs, all core faction choices including six regional affiliations, all 15 non-Psi interest packages, including independent Pilot fields, skill totals and transfers, custom Active fields, starting motivations and goals, campaign gear packs, and shared CP spending on aptitudes, skills, ego Flex, languages, reputation, and specializations are implemented. Career gear includes Covert Operative and Soldier synthmorph alternatives, errata corrections, and the Genehacker payload cost qualifier. Supported ego traits apply costs and capped bonuses, Expert Training raises one skill cap, and all six aptitude check traits add traced per-level bonuses without changing aptitude scores or skill bases. Contact and Morph Familiarity support separate scoped purchases with duplicate checks and one CP per entry. Hardening supports three non-Psi stress immunities with cumulative WIL Check and Persuade Test penalties, separate skill ratings and test targets, and specialization handling. Add broader trait coverage and exceptions, Psi with the Lost background and Async interest, gear swaps, the infomorph pack, and extra equipment purchases.

items.title: Browse, filter, and compare supported morphs
items.notes: Quick-Start search, category filters, a three-profile comparison, and source links are in place. Add verified player-profile restrictions and the planned price, movement, durability, and capability filters as the supported catalogue expands.

items.title: Verify keyboard access, mobile layouts, and print
items.notes: Run the planned accessibility audit and test the complete player workflow across supported layouts. The initial Edge PDF and grayscale review is recorded in docs/print-review.md. Verify native print-dialog controls, physical grayscale output, very long notes, and other supported browsers.

items.title: Prepare onboarding and feedback for public beta
items.notes: Document known limitations and cover the planned feedback loop, error monitoring, and privacy-respecting metrics.
